audits.salvage_note: Repair: Use skin temperature from Empatica E4 (available in WESAD) as proxy for ambient thermal influence on EDA baseline; alternatively, add day identifier as a Mondrian stratum and test per-day coverage differences without ambient logs. If skin temperature mediates day-coverage relationship, mechanism is supported.
